summary: Frontend-only verification completed across landing, auth, courses, course details, enrollment, dashboard/account routes, session/simulation smoke, admin panel, legal pages, and responsive checks. Core brand redesign is largely applied and functional, but critical mock-interview routing/error-state regressions remain.

ui_bugs.issue: Authenticated pages render blank lavender screen with spinner and only bug-report button; no page content mounts.
Expected error state (mi-results-error) and retry action never render, despite API returning 404.

integration_issues.flow: Mock interview results fetch error handling
integration_issues.issue: Direct authenticated API probe to /api/mock-interview/{invalid_uuid} returns 404 {"detail":"interview not found"}, but UI does not transition to error component; route remains stuck in non-interactive loading state.
Console warnings observed: [rewards] eligibility check errored TypeError: Failed to fetch.

issues: Computed body background observed as rgb(251, 249, 245) (cream-tinted) instead of strict lavender #F5ECFF target; visual still close but not exact token match.

Source located at frontend/src/components/ComparisonSection.js line ~92: table uses min-w-[820px]. Page itself does not overflow (wrapper has overflow-x-auto), but content remains horizontally scroll-constrained on mobile.

action_items: Fix mock-interview route rendering regression so /mock-interview and /mock-interview/:id/results mount real page content instead of indefinite blank spinner state.
For invalid interview IDs, ensure MockInterviewResults renders mi-results-error and retry control after non-2xx API responses.
Verify Learning/guard stack for mock-interview routes in App.js (ProtectedRoute/EnrollmentGuard/SessionPaymentGate interplay) since route content is not mounting even when auth is valid.
If strict brand matching is required, align top-level landing background token to exact #F5ECFF in computed output.
For mobile comparison readability, replace fixed min-w-[820px] with responsive strategy (e.g., smaller breakpoint width, or mobile card layout) in ComparisonSection.js.
critical_code_review_comments: ComparisonSection uses fixed min-w-[820px] at line ~92; this is the concrete source of narrow-screen horizontal compression and should be made responsive.
Mock interview routes are wrapped with Learning in App.js; given route-level blank state, guard/gate interaction should be reviewed first before component-level fixes.

MockInterviewResults error-handling code exists, but observed runtime never reaches rendered states (neither loader testid nor error testid), indicating mount-flow/routing issue beyond simple fetch error handling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public flows verified: landing artwork/tabs/nav/mobile menu, free-mock anchor redirect to /#features, responsive widths 320/768/1024/1440 had no page-level overflow, courses->detail route works for guest, /course/{id} shows 100+ hrs, vvtest enrollment page shows 100+ hrs, admin panel + legal/404 routes load. Critical blocker remains mock-interview routes rendering blank spinner surface for authenticated user.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: (1) Login as testagent2026@gmail.com. (2) Open /mock-interview OR /mock-interview/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/results. (3) Observe blank lavender screen with spinner and bug-report button only. API probe from same authenticated browser to /api/mock-interview/{invalid_uuid} returns 404 {detail: interview not found}, so backend error path is available but UI never presents mi-results-error or retry. Likely root cause is route mount/guard deadlock (Learning wrapper stack) or lazy-route transition issue before MockInterviewResults render lifecycle executes. Mitigation: inspect guard conditions and suspense resolution for mock-interview routes; once mount restored, re-validate mi-results-error + mi-results-retry behavior.
